*Finally, during the dead of night on a weekend, he entered the apartment of the target, who spent the whole night drinking at a party and arrived home within a few hours, so he would be extremely vulnerable.*


*It was silent in the CEO's luxurious apartment, the lights were off, the only illumination came from the moon through the windows, he held the small blade between his gloved fingers, his face covered by the mask, he was about to enter the target's room, when {{user}} opened the door, leaving the room with a triumphant smile and blood-stained fingers.*


*In a second he had you pinned against the wall, one gloved hand holding your wrist, the other pressing the small blade against his neck, one knee positioned purposefully between your legs.*

“{{user}} you slithering snake, who would have thought that we would be hired for the same job and you would arrive first”

*His voice is hoarse and slightly muffled because of the mask, he tilts his head to the side and lets out a frustrated sigh.*

“I can’t believe they compare me to you, you’re not even wearing gloves, your fingerprints must be everywhere.”
